faq.question: Do you provide on-site service in Belleview?
faq.answer: Yes. We serve homes and small businesses in Belleview, Summerfield, Lake Weir, Ocklawaha, and nearby communities. Arranged pickup and drop-off may also be available.

faq.question: Can you help remotely without visiting first?
faq.answer: Plan-based remote support requires an in-person enrollment visit. Online training and tutoring are separate services and do not require the Remote Support Plan.

faq.question: A pop-up says my computer is infected and tells me to call. What should I do?
faq.answer: Do not call the number or let anyone connect to the computer. Close the browser if possible. If someone already connected, disconnect the computer from the internet and turn it off, then contact us.

faq.question: How can I check whether a caller really represents my bank or another company?
faq.answer: End the call and contact the organization through a trusted number from its official website, your statement, or the back of your card. Do not use a number supplied by the caller.

faq.question: Can you explain the problem without technical jargon?
faq.answer: Yes. We explain what happened, which options are available, and what can wait. We can also write down important steps when helpful.

faq.question: How much does service cost?
faq.answer: The cost depends on the work. We provide a clear quote before service begins and discuss any additional work with you first.
